answer: The lantern of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, held in escrow until finality, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the lotus of a task receipt, and the dawn is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
